Server/Binders/DynamicHide.luau.description: Dynamic Hide provides the class/model implementation used by the Hide package. Public entry points include `DynamicHide.new`.

Server/Binders/Hide.luau.description: Primarily used for authoring, this hides the tagged instance from render. Great for making bounding boxes in studio that are then hidden upon runtime. See [Binder] for usage. Public entry points include `Hide.new`, `Hide.Destroy`.

Server/HideService.luau.description: Hide Service provides the service implementation used by the Hide package. Public entry points include `HideService.Init`.
